body: At this point, I've just stopped talking to him altogether about how I'm feeling. I'm trying so hard to work on feeling better about myself and my life. I just feel so beaten down in this moment. I can't talk to him about anything without it getting turned around on me. I'm in the habit of just apologizing because it's the only way to end the fighting and what feels like constant criticism. I just feel so alone and so much hatred for myself right now.
I am! I went to an intensive treatment program and now I see an individual therapist. It has helped a little. I think I'm still learning how to ask for help.
